workflow_blockers: generic repository test job installs no torch while collecting existing spatial tests that import torch
repository-wide Ruff has pre-existing findings in unrelated legacy files

selection: source-qualified patient-specific proof channels before unqualified context under a fixed call budget
capability complementarity before redundant model count
explicit peer-reviewed/model-card basis for commit-capable roles
target/test labels forbidden for expert selection
expert_pool_methodology.authority: expert availability does not imply commit authority

notes: The new algorithm intentionally does not infer DELETE transactions from report omissions.
Several RadGraph claims may share one sentence-level patch; the patch is applied only when all clinical changes represented by that identical patch are approved.
Contrastive expert image features are keyed by expert and image, preventing wrong-patient knockoff controls from accidentally reusing the current-patient feature.
Qualification cards fitted on one candidate proposal distribution cannot be reused for another proposal policy.
Replacing an expert checkpoint/adapter asset invalidates its previous source qualification through provenance mismatch.
Legacy expert role cards without an explicit literature/model-card basis may remain callable for historical compatibility but cannot receive MERIT-Tx commit authority.
MedSigLIP is optional and gated; configuration presence does not make it available or trusted.
Source references are not available to transaction decisions in run_merit_tx_source_canary.py; optional evaluation opens references only after outputs.json is frozen.
No new benchmark gain is claimed by this implementation validation.
